messages:
Lina (marketing): Quick sync: RefApp mini-release went live at 08:42 PT. Early signals look solid. Think we should run a light webinar + gated appendix to capture more dev leads.
Jon (devrel): Congrats! Do we have top-level metrics yet?
Lina (marketing): First 12h: ~3.8k pageviews, 210 newsletter signups, 7 demo requests. Hacker News dropped a small thread, also spikes from a couple of community Discords.
Alex (growth): Demo request mix? Any enterprise interest?
Sam (content): 6 startups, 1 mid-market, 0 enterprise. Most signups from the newsletter CTA.
Priya (ops): Noted 3 leads failed routing — route-bot flagged missing 'utm_source'.
route-bot: 3 leads failed routing: missing "utm_source" -> routed to 'manual-review' queue.
Lina (marketing): Oof. Can we default utm_source-> 'organic' when missing? Manual review slows pipeline.
Priya (ops): Prefer tagging default but keep a 'missing-utm' flag so SDRs can prioritize. I can push that to prod after a quick QA.
Alex (growth): For webinar idea: "Inside the RefApp: deploy, benchmarks, and cost tips" — 45 min total, demo + bench deep-dive + Q&A. Capture code downloads as a secondary CTA.
Jon (devrel): I'll draft a hands-on demo + a short bench appendix. Important: article's latency numbers were single-request microbenchmarks (batch=1). We should add a short note clarifying batched throughput vs single-request latency.
Sam (content): I'll add a "Benchmark notes" callout: \"Numbers measured on dedicated small instance with batch=1. Batching and dedicated throughput configs change tokens/sec; see appendix for full configs.\" Also propose two CTAs A/B test: "Register for the live walkthrough" vs "Get the repo + benchmark appendix".
Lina (marketing): Action items:
- Sam: update post copy with bench note + add A/B CTA (EOD)
- Priya: implement utm defaulting + reprocess the 3 missed leads (today)
- Jon: outline webinar + confirm Rafael for runtime deep-dive (tomorrow)
- Alex: create registration page + initial promo plan (48h)
Priya (ops): For reprocessing: running this script to pick filtered leads and re-route:
```bash
python tools/reprocess_leads.py --filter "missing_utm" --assign default:organic
```
Rafael (runtime): I can do the bench deep-dive. Need to know target audience (devs vs infra/ops) so I can tune slides.
Jon (devrel): Target primarily devs and ML engineers building with our hosted API and dedicated flows. Rafael, focus on runtime tradeoffs and simple config samples.
Alex (growth): Budget proposal: $600 initial sponsored posts + $150 for targeted dev ads; measure signups->demos.
Lina (marketing): Registration drip cadence: welcome + 5d reminder, 2d, 12h, 1h. Alex own emails.
Sam (content): Also want to spin a short how-to thread for Twitter linking to the repo and the gated appendix. A/B test the CTAs and track CTR->reg conversion.
Priya (ops): Routing change ready on staging, will push to prod after smoke tests in 30m. Will tag reprocessed leads with 'auto-defaulted-utm' for visibility.
Jon (devrel): I'll put Rafael, Lina, and myself as speakers. Proposed agenda: 10m intro + 15m demo + 15m benchmarks & infra + 5-10m Q&A.
Lina (marketing): Everyone mark status here as done when complete. Small ask: Sam, emphasize the bench note in bold so community readers don't misinterpret latency claims.
Sam (content): Will do. I'll post the updated paragraph and two CTA variants in this thread when ready.
Lina (marketing): Thanks team! :rocket: Keep updates coming in this thread so SDR + ops can follow the flow.
